## What it does

A hierarchical regression pipeline built on multi-decadal reservoir time series. It estimates how drought vulnerability varies among reservoirs.

## Highlights

- Hierarchical models fit in brms
- Spatial Gaussian-process extensions compared by leave-one-out cross-validation
